data.name: ServerConnectionLabel
data.value: Connect to the server to identify installed liveries

data.name: ServerConnectionDescription
data.value:
To identify the liveries installed on cars, the application sends the save file (C_ProfileData) to the server. The file is processed solely to obtain information about installed liveries and is not stored on the server.
Data from the save file is not stored or used for any other purpose. The server is used to securely store the keys required to decrypt the save file.
The server is not affiliated with the official servers of Forza Horizon, Xbox or Microsoft.

The server is not affiliated with the official servers of Forza Horizon, Xbox or Microsoft.
Data is sent to the server only with your consent. Do you want to enable the server connection?
